en: Majordomus has no deployment at all: no container, no hosting provider, no way for anyone who is not standing in front of this checkout to see the layer it serves. The obvious repair is the wrong one. A Dockerfile and a fly.toml written by hand would be a second description of facts the repository already holds — the port the server binds, the routes it registers, the assets the site build produces, the binary the workspace names — and every one of those pairs would drift the first time one half changed. The repository already refuses that shape everywhere else: capabilities are declared once and projected into CLI, HTTP, MCP, OpenAPI, docs and the site, and generate --check fails when a projection is stale. A deployment must arrive the same way or not at all.
cs: Majordomus nemá vůbec žádné nasazení: žádný kontejner, žádného hostingového poskytovatele, žádný způsob, jak by někdo, kdo nestojí před tímto checkoutem, viděl vrstvu, kterou servíruje. Zřejmá náprava je ta špatná. Ručně psaný Dockerfile a fly.toml by byly druhým popisem faktů, které repozitář už drží — port, na kterém server naslouchá, trasy, které registruje, assety, které produkuje build webu, binárka, kterou pojmenovává workspace — a každý z těchto párů by se rozešel při první změně jedné poloviny. Repozitář už takový tvar jinde odmítá: schopnosti se deklarují jednou a promítají do CLI, HTTP, MCP, OpenAPI, dokumentace a webu a generate --check selže, když je projekce zastaralá. en: <t1/> <t2>Every contradiction between an issue's declared status and its delivery (plan.delivery), each with the objects that prove it: `merged_not_recorded` — READY, BLOCKED or ACTIVE, with a merge on the trunk naming it (pull request, merge commit, release) and no open pull request naming it; `active_without_work` — ACTIVE since before the window, with no branch, pull request, merge or live mesh claim naming it; `done_without_trace` — DONE with no merge naming it, advisory because record-only issues exist. Each finding carries its age, whether it is past the window `.ai/repo/ci/plan.yaml` declares (`drift.window`, seconds), the sources that were not read and could have dissolved it, and the command that settles it (`majordomus plan verify|done <id>`). With `gate`, judged as a gate: on a `head` every merged_not_recorded is pending; on the `trunk` one merged longer than the window ago is refused and a younger one pending; the other classes never refuse; a missing or unreadable window refuses (exit 12); refusals fail the gate (exit 10) only under `drift.enforcement: blocking`, and are reported with exit 0 under `advisory`. Observed live, or `at` a commit as plan.delivery is. Inferred on every call; it never writes a stamp.</t2> <t3> <t4>query</t4> <t5>experimental</t5> <t6>mcp</t6> <t7>http</t7> <t8>cli</t8> </t3>

Každý nález nese své stáří, zda je za oknem, které deklaruje `.ai/repo/ci/plan.yaml` (`drift.window`, sekundy), zdroje, které nebyly přečteny a mohly ho rozpustit, a příkaz, který ho urovná (`majordomus plan verify|done <id>`). en: Nothing in the tool could have refused it. Both mechanisms that exist compare <t1>declared strings</t1>: <t2/> reads other worktrees' <t3/> scopes and compares path containment, and the peer board compares announced claims. Neither reads a working tree. And the decisive detail is that the author of those edits — this session — had never called <t4/> at all: the paths that were swallowed were claimed nowhere, by anyone, and were nonetheless obviously in flight to anything that looked at <t5/>. <t6/> exists for the mirror-image case and says so in its own header: <t7>"a peer board is a process's memory — it says who is working now, and says nothing about the branch somebody pushed an hour before"</t7>. This is the third case: not a pushed branch, not an announcement, but a dirty file on a disk two processes share.
cs: Nic v nástroji to nemohlo odmítnout. Oba existující mechanismy porovnávají <t1>deklarované řetězce</t1>: <t2/> čte rozsahy <t3/> jiných worktrees a porovnává obsažení cest, a nástěnka peerů porovnává oznámená tvrzení. Žádný nečte pracovní strom. A rozhodující detail je, že autor těch úprav — tato relace — nikdy nezavolal <t4/> vůbec: cesty, které byly pohlceny, nebyly nárokovány nikde, nikým, a přesto byly zjevně rozpracované pro všechno, co se podívalo na <t5/>. <t6/> existuje pro zrcadlový případ a v hlavičce to říká: <t7>„nástěnka peerů je paměť procesu — říká, kdo pracuje teď, a nic neříká o branchi, kterou někdo pushnul před hodinou“</t7>.
